예레미야-42-1.title: 예레미야 42장 1절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-1.exegesis: 18. afraid-- lest the Chaldeans should suspect all the Jews of being implicated in Ishmael's treason, as though the Jews sought to have a prince of the house of David ( Jr 41:1 ). Their better way towards gaining God's favor would have been to have laid the blame on the real culprit, and to have cleared themselves. A tortuous policy is the parent of fear. Righteousness inspires with boldness ( Psa 53:5 ; Pr 28:1 ).

예레미야-42-3.title: 예레미야 42장 3절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-3.exegesis: CHAPTER 42 Jr 42:1-22 . The Jews and Johanan Inquire of God, through Jeremiah, as to Going to Egypt, Promising Obedience to His Will. Their Safety on Condition of Staying in Judea, and Their Destruction in the Event of Going to Egypt, Are Foretold. Their Hypocrisy in Asking for Counsel Which They Meant Not to Follow, if Contrary to Their Own Determination, Is Reproved. 2. Jeremiah-- He probably was one of the number carried off from Mizpah, and dwelt with Johanan ( Jr 41:16 ). Hence the expression is, "came near" ( Jr 42:1 ), not "sent." Let ... supplication be accepted-- literally, "fall" (see on Jr 36:7 ; Jr 37:20 ). pray for us-- ( Ge 20:7 ; Is 37:4 ; Jas 5:16 ). thy God-- ( Jr 42:5 ). The Jews use this form to express their belief in the peculiar relation in which Jeremiah stood to God as His accredited prophet. Jeremiah in his reply reminds them that God is their God ("your God") as well as his as being the covenant people ( Jr 42:4 ). They in turn acknowledge this in Jr 42:6 , "the Lord our God." few of many-- as had been foretold ( Le 26:22 ).

예레미야-42-4.title: 예레미야 42장 4절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-4.exegesis: 3. They consulted God, like many, not so much to know what was right, as wishing Him to authorize what they had already determined on, whether agreeable to His will or not. So Ahab in consulting Micaiah ( 1Ki 22:13 ). Compare Jeremiah's answer ( Jr 42:4 ) with Micaiah's ( 1Ki 22:14 ).

예레미야-42-5.exegesis: 4. I have heard-- that is, I accede to your request. your God-- Being His by adoption, ye are not your own, and are bound to whatever He wills ( Ex 19:5 , 6 ; 1Co 6:19 , 20 ). answer you-- that is, through me. keep nothing back-- ( 1Sa 3:18 ; Ac 20:20 ).

예레미야-42-6.exegesis: 5. Lord be a true ... witness-- ( Ge 31:50 ; Psa 89:37 ; Re 1:5 ; 3:14 ; 19:11).

예레미야-42-7.title: 예레미야 42장 7절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-7.exegesis: 6. evil-- not moral evil, which God cannot command ( Jas 1:13 ), but what may be disagreeable and hard to us. Piety obeys God, without questioning, at all costs. See the instance defective in this, that it obeyed only so far as was agreeable to itself ( 1Sa 15:3 , 9, 13-15 , 20-23 ).

예레미야-42-8.title: 예레미야 42장 8절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-8.exegesis: 7. ten days-- Jeremiah did not speak of himself, but waited God's time and revelation, showing the reality of his inspiration. Man left to himself would have given an immediate response to the people, who were impatient of delay. The delay was designed to test the sincerity of their professed willingness to obey, and that they should have full time to deliberate ( De 8:2 ). True obedience bows to God's time, as well as His way and will.

예레미야-42-11.title: 예레미야 42장 11절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-11.exegesis: 10. If ye ... abide-- namely, under the Babylonian authority, to which God hath appointed that all should be subject ( Da 2:37 , 38). To resist was to resist God. build ... plant-- metaphor for, I will firmly establish you ( Jr 24:6 ). I repent ... of the evil-- ( Jr 18:8 ; De 32:36 ). I am satisfied with the punishment I have inflicted on you, if only you add not a new offense [Grotius]. God is said to "repent," when He alters His outward ways of dealing.

예레미야-42-13.title: 예레미야 42장 13절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-13.exegesis: 12. show mercies-- rather, I will excite (in him) feelings of mercy towards you [Calvin]. cause you to return-- permit you to return to the peaceable enjoyment of the possessions from which you are wishing to withdraw through fear of the Chaldeans. By departing in disobedience they should incur the very evils they wished thereby to escape; and by staying they should gain the blessings which they feared to lose by doing so.

예레미야-42-14.exegesis: 13. if ye say, &c.-- avowed rebellion against God, who had often ( De 17:16 ), as now, forbidden their going to Egypt, lest they should be entangled in its idolatry.

예레미야-42-15.title: 예레미야 42장 15절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-15.exegesis: 14. where we shall see no war-- Here they betray their impiety in not believing God's promise ( Jr 42:10 , 11 ), as if He were a liar ( 1Jo 5:10 ).
예레미야-42-15.theologicalNote: 14. where we shall see no war-- Here they betray their impiety in not believing God's promise ( Jr 42:10 , 11 ), as if He were a liar ( 1Jo 5:10 ).

예레미야-42-16.exegesis: 15. wholly set your faces-- firmly resolve ( Lu 9:51 ) in spite of all warnings ( Jr 44:12 ).
예레미야-42-16.theologicalNote: 15. wholly set your faces-- firmly resolve ( Lu 9:51 ) in spite of all warnings ( Jr 44:12 ).

예레미야-42-17.title: 예레미야 42장 17절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-17.exegesis: 16. sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you-- The very evils we think to escape by sin, we bring on ourselves thereby. What our hearts are most set on often proves fatal to us. Those who think to escape troubles by changing their place will find them wherever they go ( Eze 11:8 ). The "sword" here is that of Nebuchadnezzar, who fulfilled the prediction in his expedition to Africa (according to Megasthenes, a heathen writer), 300 B.C.

예레미야-42-18.title: 예레미야 42장 18절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-18.exegesis: 17. all the men-- excepting the "small number" mentioned ( Jr 44:14 , 28 ); namely, those who were forced into Egypt against their will, Jeremiah, Baruch, &c., and those who took Jeremiah's advice and fled from Egypt before the arrival of the Chaldeans.

예레미야-42-19.title: 예레미야 42장 19절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-19.exegesis: 18. As mine anger, &c.-- As ye have already, to your sorrow, found Me true to My word, so shall ye again ( Jr 7:20 ; 18:16 ). shall see this place no more-- Ye shall not return to Judea, as those shall who have been removed to Babylon.

예레미야-42-20.title: 예레미야 42장 20절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-20.exegesis: 19. I have admonished-- literally, "testified," that is, solemnly admonished, having yourselves as My witnesses; so that if ye perish, ye yourselves will have to confess that it was through your own fault, not through ignorance, ye perished.

예레미야-42-21.title: 예레미야 42장 21절 역사문법적 주해
예레미야-42-21.exegesis: 20. dissembled in your hearts-- rather, "ye have used deceit against your (own) souls." It is not God, but yourselves, whom ye deceive, to your own ruin, by your own dissimulation ( Ga 6:7 ) [Calvin]. But the words following accord best with English Version, ye have dissembled in your hearts (see on Jr 42:3 ) towards me, when ye sent me to consult God for you.

예레미야-42-22.exegesis: 21. declared it-- namely, the divine will. I ... but ye-- antithesis. I have done my part; but ye do not yours. It is no fault of mine that ye act not rightly.
